title: Spain Castilla-La Mancha Crop fields
description: Official field boundaries for the Castilla-La Mancha region of Spain, derived from the SIGPAC geographic information system used to administer EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) aid. The dataset covers 6,453,236 parcels and includes crop classification codes and administrative codes at province and municipality level. Data is distributed as fiboa-compliant GeoParquet.

providers.name: Unidad de Cartografía. Secretaría General. Consejería de Agricultura , Ganadería y Desarrollo Rural.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain 

Provides 6453236 official field boundaries from Spain .
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Castilla-la-Mancha.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Castilla-la-Mancha](https://datosabiertos.castillalamancha.es/dataset/sistema-de-informaci%C3%B3n-geogr%C3%A1fica-de-parcelas-agr%C3%ADcolas-de-castilla-la-mancha-sigpac)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-SA-4.0 (see https://datosabiertos.castillalamancha.es/dataset/sistema-de-informaci%C3%B3n-geogr%C3%A1fica-de-parcelas-agr%C3%ADcolas-de-castilla-la-mancha-sigpac)
- **Projection:** EPSG:25830

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cm/es_cm.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cm/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cm/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cm/es_cm.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property                | **Data Type** | Description |
|-------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                      | string        |             |
| admin_province_code     | string        |             |
| admin_municipality_code | string        |             |
| area                    | float         |             |
| crop:code               | string        |             |
| crop:name               | string        |             |
| crop:name_en            | string        |             |
| admin:country_code      | string        |             |
| crop:code_list          | string        |             |
| admin:subdivision_code  | string        |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-12-30 from:
  - REST
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
